newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Cho Hung Bank '96 net rises.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Cho Hung Bank '96 net rises.

text.p: South Korea's Cho Hung Bank posted a provisional net profit of 110.24 billion won in calendar 1996, up from earnings of 106.63 billion won a year earlier, a company official said on Friday.
The official said turnover was 2.49 trillion won, against 2.129 trillion a year earlier.
Profit before taxes was 154.4 billion won, against 126 billion, while earnings per share was put at 666 won, against 650 won in 1995.
The 1996 cash dividend was five percent, or 250 won, against four percent, or 200 won a year earlier.
The dividends would be payable on March 7, when the shareholders meeting was scheduled, he said. Final figures would be available at that time.
